hero.title: Neighbors in Seabright, working together.
hero.lead: One place to keep each other informed, share what we learn, and decide together what to do next.

mission.title: Why we're here
paragraphs: Seabright is changing, and the people who live here want a real say in how. This is where we stay in touch between meetings, so nobody has to rely on a group text to know what's going on.
Every voice here is heard equally. We use real names, and the tools here are shaped by the people who use them.

items.title: Staying informed
items.body: News, announcements and what people have learned, in one feed. The important things stay pinned at the top.

items.title: Showing up
items.body: Meetings and events on a shared map of the neighborhood, so it's easy to see what's happening and where.

items.title: Researching together
items.body: Sources, notes and open questions, linked to each other and to the places they're about.

join.title: How to join

steps.title: Get an invite link
steps.body: From a neighbor who's already in, or scan the code at a meeting.

steps.title: Continue with Google or your email
steps.body: No password to remember. We email you a link if you'd rather not use Google.

steps.title: Tell us your name
steps.body: And, if you like, how you'd want to help. That's it.

join.no_invite: No invite yet? Ask someone you know in the group, or come to the next meeting.

footer: Made by neighbors, for neighbors. Built on Agora.
